ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized strictly to scarring and barnacle clusters representing <5% of the total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark-grey to black field covering the majority of the fluke; discrete high-contrast white clusters located at the extreme lateral tips; several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks localized in the mid-right and mid-left lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees; apex terminates in a sharp point at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays more jagged, irregular peaks while the right lobe shows a sequence of smoother, undulating scallops interrupted by three distinct deep notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a moderate convex curve from the base toward the tips; the trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal orientation with a slight upward concavity toward the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (acorn barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes; approximately 12-15 distinct units visible on the left tip and 8-10 on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear disruptions present; two prominent, near-parallel vertical lines on the right lobe (rake marks) and several shorter, fainter diagonal marks on the left lobe near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the right lobe surface; heavy biological encrustation (barnacles) on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, high-intensity circular punctate marks located immediately adjacent to the median notch on the interior surface of the lobes.
